# S1.11 — Land the reference-monitor security kernel & capability model (§5g.1, R-2.8.1 C0/Stage 1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5g.1 (`R-2.8.1` — the C0/Stage-1 slice per
§5g.1 §9) · ADR-0051/0052/0053 (as amended) · ADR-0069 · ADR-0059 D4 ·
ADR-0087 D3 · ADR-0090 · ADR-0024 · ADR-0031/0032 · ADR-0033/0034/0035 ·
ADR-0026/0029/0030 · ADR-0100 · ADR-0185 · ADR-0191 · ADR-0212 · ADR-0217
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/015_S1.11__reference-monitor.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.8.1**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.10` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live

## Summary
Lands the reference monitor's C0/Stage-1 slice as the new **persistent** crate
`crates/hh-monitor` — the kernel's one decision point for every proposed
effect (deps wire/identity/provenance/ontology/hir/assembly/compiler/ledger
only; **no `Text` leaf and no model call on any path** — enforced by
construction, by the `tcb` source scan, and by the `guard::DecisionGuard`
runtime trip):

- **`AuthorityHandle` + the handle-table projection** (`handle.rs`,
  `table.rs`) — the §3 record verbatim (allocated opaque `hnd-` ids, grants,
  ceiling, validity, `parent_handle`, `delegable`, `origin_basis ∈
  {seal, approval, policy_rule, delegation, pin}`); `HandleTable` is a
  *derived view* folded from `security.permission.granted`/`revoked` with
  `project` rebuild equality, per-(handle,grant) `count` usage meters and the
  one-transaction revocation cascade (I-H4).
- **Root minting** (`mint.rs`) — `mint_root_handles` walks the sealed
  definition's `Permission` entities, checks `issuer.authority ≥ principal`
  and the node's conferring origin ∉ `{model, evolution, participant}`
  (`IllegitimateIssuer`), intersects every applicable `authority_cap`
  (named + global `*`), and mints `origin_basis = seal` handles **before any
  untrusted read** — the function takes no content input at all (H-3).
- **`authorize` steps 0–3 and 6** (`monitor.rs`) — step 0 well-formedness
  (`MissingProvenance`/`UnknownProposer`/mapped args), step 1
  `min(authority(proposer), context_label)` + taint union (never raises),
  step 2 domain+scope coverage over **canonical** parameters with
  count/time constraint exhaustion (`NoCoveringGrant`/`HandleRevoked`/
  `GrantConstraintExhausted`), step 3 `max_by_danger` risk (declared
  attributes joined with recorded assessor inputs; self-report raise-only;
  `unknown ⇒ irreversible`), step 6 spawn attenuation; step 4 lands as its
  authority-form half — the Π gate for `eff ≤ external ∨ taint ≠ ∅` and the
  ADR-0031 floor otherwise, with Π-12's unattended `ask →
  deny{UnattendedAsk}` on both paths (ADR-0242 §7).
- **The Π interpreter + default table** (`policy.rs`) —
  `PolicyTable{version_id, mode, rows, default: deny, unattended_policy}`
  (MUST-data at `definition` authority), the closed condition sum, deny > ask
  > allow dominance with Π-7's raise pass, Π-1…12 floor rows, the
  domain-default rows (`fs_*`/`exec`/`net_egress`/`secret_access`/`spend`/
  `message_human`/`spawn_process`/`memory_write`/`permission_request`/
  `model_call`), the ADR-0059 `secret_access` rows, and `policy_delta`
  widening/narrowing classification over a probe grid.
- **Recorded assessor inputs** (`assess.rs`) — `AssessmentInputs` is the
  closed record of what executor-registered assessors computed at `resolve`
  (ADR-0100): canonical path + writable-root containment, command class,
  host-in-allowlist, compensation registered, child containment, secret
  transport, destination∈grant.scope, spend-over-soft, pre-authorization —
  every member `Tri{yes,no,unknown}` where `unknown` reads as the dangerous
  answer.
- **The `SurfaceArgMap` evaluator** (`args.rs`, TCB item viii) — surface
  args → canonical parameters through the compiled `SurfaceBinding`;
  unmapped argument ⇒ `UnmappedArgument`; a scope-bearing parameter absent
  from `scope_bindings` ⇒ `UnscopedParameter`; `scope_bindings_unknown` ⇒
  only a `*` grant covers (ADR-0087 D3; the interim `{literal, prefix-*,
  *}` matcher under OQ-132 — ADR-0242 §4).
- **Downward-only `delegate`** (`delegate.rs`) — `ChildSpec` request packing;
  every requested grant ⊆ a `delegable` parent grant (domain, class, scope,
  count/time/budget tightening) else `AuthorityWidening`/`NotDelegable`/
  `BudgetExceedsParent`/`CeilingExceeded`/`ParentNotLive`; `ceiling =
  min(requested, parent.ceiling)`; the `environment` floor refuses
  `fs_write`/`exec`/`secret_access`.
- **Boundary enforcement** — `leak.rs` `HandleLeak` scans (static over
  compiled surfaces + runtime over outgoing context); `tcb.rs` carries the
  §2.6 inside/outside lists *as data* plus the string-blanked token scan;
  `guard.rs` trips `ModelCallDuringDecision`; `context.rs` is the kernel's
  `context_label` stamp (I-H9 — the variant chooses *what* to deliver, never
  the label).
- **Complete mediation in `hh-ledger`** (`effect.rs`) — `DecisionFolds`
  keyed on `(effect_id, attempt_no)`: `committed` refuses
  `Undecided` without a preceding `decided{allow}`; a second final `decided`
  per attempt cycle is `DuplicateDecision`; the lenient rebuild fold
  reproduces gate state after reopen (ADR-0242 §2).
- **`hh-compiler` E2 totality** (`equiv.rs`) — a surface field absent from
  `arg_map` now fails compilation rather than compiling unchecked
  (AC-R-2.8.1-10 static half; ADR-0242 §9).

`DenyReason` is the §3 closed sum verbatim (Stage-2 members declared, never
emitted) and `Decider` the one CF-153/CF-312 sum (`policy` only at Stage 1);
`KernelDecision` omits the Stage-2 members rather than nulling them (CC8).

## Deviations / owned decisions
ADR-0242 — crate shape and deps; the `(effect_id, attempt_no)`-keyed
mediation fold (strict append, lenient rebuild); recorded `AssessmentInputs`
on the `Proposal`; the interim fail-closed scope matcher under OQ-132;
I-H2's `issuer.origin` read from node provenance; the Stage-1 authorize-step
split; declared-complete closed sums; E2 totality; the TCB enumeration as
data.

## Live stage
n/a — offline-only; the monitor is a pure function over canonical records.
No secrets, no network, no clock/env reads; verification is the cargo
suites.
